description: Paragraphs of the US hazardous materials rule for lithium batteries (49 CFR 173.185, eCFR) that mention a keyword such as 'aircraft' or 'UN3480'. This is the US rule text, not the IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (which are a paid publication) and not a legal opinion. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

keyword.description: Word or phrase to find, 3 to 40 characters (default aircraft)
